notes: Calibrate to my punch hole: a full-screen aligner that draws into the cutout area so you can drag the island onto your real camera, wherever it sits
The stand-in lens has its own size and position, for off-centre punch holes
Release builds are shrunk with R8 — the APK is now under 2 MB instead of 12.6 MB
A separate Play build with no in-app updater, for anyone publishing it
Crash log kept on device, with Share diagnostics and Clear in About
Settings now travel to a new phone through Android backup
Content descriptions on every icon-only control, for TalkBack
